theme_customization_blueprint.title: CKB Directory Theme Creation Guide
theme_customization_blueprint.description: Use this JSON template to design custom style themes for the CKB Directory Android app and submit them via PR or issue.

displayName.description: Name shown to users in the settings screen

colorScheme.primary: Hex color code for primary accents (e.g., button overlays, active selections)
colorScheme.secondary: Hex color code for secondary UI details
colorScheme.background: Hex color code for base fallback background
colorScheme.surface: Hex color code for cards, settings dialogs, and navigation containers

splash.bgColor: Hex color code for splash screen base background
splash.imageFileName: Name of the splash background PNG/Vector drawable asset to be placed in res/drawable

home_hero.imageFileName: Name of the home panel hero background image (should have an aspect ratio of 2.5:1, e.g. 500x200px)

bgGradientColors.description: List of hex color codes for the main application background gradient (smooth vertical gradient)

headerStyle.fontStyle: Visual font and text treatment mode. Supported values: 'classic' (default bold), 'neon' (glowing text), 'ocean' (cyan underlines/shadows), 'stealth' (monospace minimal)
headerStyle.showGlow: Boolean indicating whether to apply a radial glowing effect behind page headers
headerStyle.textGradient: Array of hex colors to draw text characters as a gradient (optional)

icons.home: XML resource name of the custom vector icon to show in the Home tab
icons.news: XML resource name of the custom vector icon to show in the News tab
icons.apps: XML resource name of the custom vector icon to show in the Apps tab
icons.tools: XML resource name of the custom vector icon to show in the Tools tab
icons.settings: XML resource name of the custom vector icon to show in the Settings tab

how_to_submit: 1. Place your custom drawable files (splash PNG, hero banner JPG/PNG, and custom tab SVGs/XMLs) inside the '/app/src/main/res/drawable/' folder.
2. Define your theme attributes matching this JSON structure.
4. Submit a Pull Request to the main CKB Directory repository.
